metadata.question: Regarding land use in the Guayas River delta, based on Landsat 8 imagery from August 29, 2024, is the area within a 1km radius of coordinates -2.306934, -79.887682 predominantly shrimp farming rather than mangrove forest?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Landsat 8 Collection 2 Level-2 SR (LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2) filtered to the 1 km radius around the point (-79.887682, -2.306934) on 2024-08-29. If empty, try Landsat 9 (LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2) same date as a fallback.
2. Masking strategy: Mask clouds, cirrus, cloud shadow, and snow using QA_PIXEL bits. Compute NDVI and MNDWI from scaled SR bands.
3. Logic for validity: Check collection size (C1), then valid pixel count after masking (C2). Compute shrimp proxy fraction (MNDWI≥0.3 and NDVI<0.35) vs mangrove fraction (NDVI≥0.55). If either fraction is null/NaN, output C3. If shrimp fraction > mangrove fraction, answer A; else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function getInfo(obj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.getInfo((res, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(res);
    });
  });
}

function maskLandsatSR(img) {
  var qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
  var mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0) // Dilated cloud
    .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0))    // Cirrus
    .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0))    // Cloud
    .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0))    // Cloud shadow
    .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0));   // Snow
  var scaled = img.select(['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B6','SR_B7'])
                  .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
  return img.addBands(scaled, null, true).updateMask(mask);
}

function addIndices(img) {
  var ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5','SR_B4']).rename('NDVI');
  var mndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3','SR_B6']).rename('MNDWI');
  return img.addBands([ndvi, mndwi]);
}

function addValidCount(img, roi) {
  var validCount = img.select('SR_B4').reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry: roi,
    scale: 1000,
    maxPixels: 1e9,
    bestEffort: true
  }).get('SR_B4');
  return img.set('validCount', validCount);
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    var lon = -79.887682;
    var lat = -2.306934;
    var roi = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]).buffer(1000);
    var start = '2024-08-29';
    var end = '2024-08-30';

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    var colL8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filterBounds(roi)
      .map(maskLandsatSR)
      .map(addIndices)
      .map(function(i){ return addValidCount(i, roi); });

    var l8Count = await getInfo(colL8.size());
    console.log(`Date: 2024-08-29; L8 images: ${l8Count}`);

    var img = null;
    var usedFallback = false;

    if (l8Count === 0) {
      // Try Landsat 9 fallback same date
      var colL9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(roi)
        .map(maskLandsatSR)
        .map(addIndices)
        .map(function(i){ return addValidCount(i, roi); });
      var l9Count = await getInfo(colL9.size());
      console.log(`L9 images (fallback): ${l9Count}`);
      if (l9Count === 0) {
        console.log("No images on the date in ROI.");
        console.log("C1");
        return;
      } else {
        img = colL9.sort('validCount', false).first();
        usedFallback = true;
      }
    } else {
      img = colL8.sort('validCount', false).first();
    }

    // 3. Valid pixels and cloud percentage
    var validCount = ee.Number(img.get('validCount'));
    var totalCount = ee.Image(1).rename('one').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true
    }).get('one');

    var validCountVal = await getInfo(validCount);
    var totalCountVal = await getInfo(totalCount);
    if (validCountVal === 0 || totalCountVal === 0) {
      console.log(`Valid px (1km): ${validCountVal} / ${totalCountVal}`);
      console.log("C2");
      return;
    }
    var cloudPct = (1 - (validCountVal / totalCountVal)) * 100;

    var productId = await getInfo(img.get('LANDSAT_PRODUCT_ID'));
    if (!productId) productId = await getInfo(img.get('system:index'));
    var collectionUsed = usedFallback ? 'L9' : 'L8';
    console.log(`Selected: ${collectionUsed} ${productId}`);
    console.log(`Valid px (1km): ${validCountVal} / ${totalCountVal}; Cloud%: ${cloudPct.toFixed(1)}`);

    // 4. Classification: Shrimp vs Mangrove proxies
    var ndvi = img.select('NDVI');
    var mndwi = img.select('MNDWI');

    var mangroveMask = ndvi.gte(0.55).rename('mangrove');
    var shrimpMask = mndwi.gte(0.30).and(ndvi.lt(0.35)).rename('shrimp');

    var stats = ee.Image.cat([mangroveMask, shrimpMask]).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().forEachBand(ee.Image.cat([mangroveMask, shrimpMask])),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true
    });

    var mangroveFrac = await getInfo(stats.get('mangrove_mean'));
    var shrimpFrac = await getInfo(stats.get('shrimp_mean'));

    console.log(`Shrimp frac: ${Number(shrimpFrac).toFixed(3)}; Mangrove frac: ${Number(mangroveFrac).toFixed(3)}`);

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if (
      mangroveFrac === null || shrimpFrac === null ||
      isNaN(mangroveFrac) || isNaN(shrimpFrac)
    ) {
      console.log("C3");
      return;
    }

    // Decide: predominantly shrimp farming rather than mangrove forest?
    if (shrimpFrac > mangroveFrac) {
      console.log("A");
    } else {
      console.log("B");
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log("D");
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
